name: loading-contract
args: import sys,types,unittest; from pathlib import Path; tests=types.ModuleType('tests'); tests.__path__=[str(Path(sys.argv[1])/'tests')]; sys.modules['tests']=tests; result=unittest.TextTestRunner().run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.loading_checks')); sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
